subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Campbell's Monomyth
description: Learn Campbell's Monomyth in one minute.

hook.text: In 1949, Joseph Campbell published The Hero with a Thousand Faces and changed how we read every story.

buildup.text: Campbell studied myths from dozens of cultures and found the same plot repeating across all of them.

discovery.text: He called it the monomyth: one universal story structure underlying myths from Greece to Japan.

twist.text: George Lucas used Campbell's framework to build Star Wars. A scholar's theory became Hollywood's Bible.

climax.text: The monomyth says heroes everywhere follow the same arc: departure, initiation, and return.

quiz.question: Who developed the concept of the monomyth?
